Steenee

Grass

Alola · Generation 7

Steenee is a Grass-type Fruit Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 8.2 kg. It evolves from Bounsweet and into Tsareena. Its highest base stat is Speed (62), with a base stat total of 290.
